title: 第1372章 紫嫣重生第1371章 耀小庸
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
擂台之上，比拼一场接续一场。
各路天骄轮番登台，每一场对决都精彩绝伦，将天玄少年一代的绝代风华尽数展现。
数轮比试落幕，狐小蝶清亮的声音再度响起：
“接下来第十五场，亦是首轮的最后一场对决！
由无尽海敖雄，对战南离紫薇！”
擂台后两道光门灵光微微闪烁，两道身影稳稳落于擂台正中。
一侧的紫薇不过十四五岁年纪，一袭浅紫罗裙，裙袂飘飘。
她身姿玲珑，面容绝美，气质却宛若雪中青莲般冷冽。
手中一柄细长青玉宝剑寒芒微闪，小小年纪却自带一番孤高风骨。
对面的敖雄，年岁与她相仿，却生得膀大腰圆，体魄魁梧，自带龙族天生的威势。
他手中紧握一柄黝黑巨锤，气势凶悍霸道。
紫薇身影现身高台之上，担任评判官的黄大牙等人，神色皆是微微一怔。
就连观礼席上的老龟、魏老怪一众人，目光也不由自主地落在紫薇身上，久久停留。
“勿大惊小怪，长得像而已。”
黄大牙轻声提醒，众人不动声色，面色恢复如常。
台下万千观者议论声又起：
“这女子生得这般绝色清冷，可是之前，我却从未在天玄天骄中听过她的名号。”
“孤陋寡闻！大比选手的简介上有，她是近期突然冒头的新人。
此前默默无闻，却是在最后关头强势逆袭。
她挑战南离排位第三的天骄，堪堪拿下这最后一个参赛名额。”

“她怕是绝非敖雄对手。敖雄可是无尽海龙族妖孽，肉身冠绝同辈！”
人群里，落尘目光定格在擂台上那身影上，心绪剧烈翻涌，险些脱口唤出“小师姐”。
眼前之人，容貌、气韵、风骨，无一不与昔日的紫嫣全然重合，分毫不差。
除却再世为人的紫嫣，世间再无第二人。
当年，落尘亲自将紫嫣神魂交付冥界护法，让紫嫣进入轮回。
又特意叮嘱保留前世记忆，年满十八，再解封记忆。
此后他未曾干预，顺其自然，任由这缕神魂入世轮回。
没想到，时隔十五年，涅盘重生的紫嫣，会立于天玄最盛大的天骄擂台之上。
赢天亦是满脸惊奇，忍不住轻声发问：
“这少女，莫非是魅姬的妹妹？”
他不知紫嫣重生的过往，故而有此猜测。
落尘下意识道：
“她是我的小师姐紫嫣，重生归来了。简直与从前一模一样。”
话音落下，无数尘封的过往涌上心头：
年少懵懂之时，神墟福地，自己与紫嫣、清婉在师尊曦门下，朝夕相伴。
后来种种变故——紫嫣被魅姬夺舍，又被九幽种下魂种。
命运跌宕辗转，最终，魅姬却成为伴他左右的道侣，而紫嫣却只剩下一缕残魂。
世事浮沉轮转，万般因果牵绊。
纵使身为创世神明的落尘，此刻也难免心绪翻涌、百感交集。
赢天缓缓开口附和：

“你小师姐重生？好！冥界重塑，她方能进入轮回。
这份造化，归根结底皆是你的功劳。”
落尘目光锁在紫薇身上，似自语般轻声呢喃：
“我的小师姐，这一世，比上一世强大太多了……”
content_en:
On the stage, competitions continued one after another.
Prodigies from all walks of life take turns to take the stage, and every duel is exciting, fully displaying the unparalleled elegance of Tianxuan's young generation.
After several rounds of competition came to an end, Hu Xiaodie's clear voice sounded again:
“The next fifteenth game is also the last showdown of the first round!
Aoxiong from Endless Sea fights against Ziwei from Nanli! "
The light from the two light gates behind the ring flickered slightly, and two figures landed steadily in the middle of the ring.
Ziwei on one side is only fourteen or fifteen years old, wearing a light purple skirt with fluttering skirts.
She has an exquisite figure and a beautiful face, but her temperament is as cold as a green lotus in the snow.
The slender green jade sword in his hand shimmered with cold light, and he had a certain aloofness at such a young age.
Opposite her, Ao Xiong was similar in age to her, but he was tall and muscular, possessing the natural power of the dragon clan.
He held a dark giant hammer tightly in his hand, with a fierce and domineering aura.
Ziwei's figure appeared on the high platform. Huang Daya and others, who were the judges, all looked slightly startled.
Even Old Turtle and Wei Wei in the audience's seats couldn't help but fall on Ziwei and stay there for a long time.
"Don't make a fuss, it's just that they look alike."
Huang Daya reminded softly, everyone remained calm and their expressions returned to normal.
Thousands of spectators in the audience started talking again:
"This woman is born with such stunning beauty and coldness, but I have never heard of her name among the Tianxuan geniuses before."
"Ignorant! According to the profile of the contestant, she is a newcomer who has suddenly emerged recently.
It was unknown before, but it made a strong counterattack at the last moment.
She challenged Nanli's third-ranked Tianjiao and was worthy of winning the last place in the competition. "
"I'm afraid she is no match for Ao Xiong. Ao Xiong is a monster from the Endless Sea Dragon Clan, and his physical body is the best among his peers!"
In the crowd, Luochen's eyes were fixed on the figure on the ring, his emotions surged violently, and he almost blurted out "little senior sister".
The appearance, charm, and character of the person in front of her are all exactly the same as those of Zi Yan in the past.
Except for Zi Yan, who is reincarnated as a human being, there is no other person in the world.
Back then, Luochen personally delivered Zi Yan's soul to the protector of the underworld, allowing Zi Yan to enter reincarnation.
He also specifically told me to keep the memory of my past life and unblock my memory when I turn eighteen.
He has not interfered since then, letting nature take its course and allowing this soul to reincarnate in the world.
Unexpectedly, after fifteen years, Zi Yan, who had been reborn from nirvana, would stand on the grandest genius arena in Tianxuan.
Yingtian was also full of surprise and couldn't help but ask softly:
"Could this girl be Mei Ji's sister?"
He didn't know the past of Zi Yan's rebirth, so he made this guess.
Luochen said subconsciously:
"She is my little senior sister Zi Yan, she has been reborn. She is exactly the same as before."
As the words fell, countless dusty past memories came to mind:
When I was young and ignorant, I, Zi Yan and Qing Wan were together day and night under Master Xi's sect in the blessed land of Shenxu.
Later, various changes occurred - Zi Yan was taken away by Mei Ji, and her soul was planted by Jiu You.
Destiny took many twists and turns, but in the end, Mei Ji became his Taoist companion, while Zi Yan only had a remnant soul left.
Things in the world are ups and downs, and all kinds of causes and effects are involved.
Even if he is Luochen, the creator god, it is inevitable that his mind will be full of emotions and mixed feelings at this moment.
Yingtian slowly spoke and agreed:
"Your little senior sister is reborn? Okay! Only after the underworld is reshaped can she enter reincarnation.
In the final analysis, this creation is all your fault. "
Luochen's eyes were locked on Ziwei, and he murmured softly as if talking to himself:
"My little senior sister, this life is much stronger than the last one..."
